topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't help but stew over what I've learned. The neighbor, who's always so modest, turns out to be incredibly wealthy. It's not the revelation itself that’s so hard to swallow, but the way everything else now seems to whisper of pretense. The old sedan, the patched jacket—were they all just a show? It makes me uneasy, thinking about how I might have treated them differently, how we all might have. Now, every conversation feels tinted with a layer of falsehood, and I find myself wondering how many others around me are walking the same tightrope. It’s a strange feeling, knowing too much, and not knowing where to put it.
